PR218 froze the 21 isotope/charge populations. This draft first preserved the completed atomic quotient pilot: 82 quotient trajectories, one independent 18-fraction reference, three tighter controls, and the saved figures/review. Its scoped preliminary atomic test-fluid admission remains unchanged.

This additive tritium audit traces the inherited exact-zero T census, then computes DD production and decay over the 82 saved backgrounds with zero new background IVPs. A separate conditional all-bare, instant-thermalization passive network includes all 16 supplied nuclear dossier labels (13 deduplicated families) plus five declared Li/D closure families. The independent reviews admit the DD calculation and the 18-family network as PASS_SCOPED under their stated model. The network has 34 physical directed channels, including eight explicit external-photon support zeros. No production-default, empirical rate-accuracy, coupled gas/ionic/fast-product, or all-physics admission follows.

The standalone final archive includes the earlier 83 saved atomic NPZ histories, current code, RUN19 intake, numerical repair evidence, raw network/DD outputs, plots, source-intake report, review, and AGENTS.md: 353 members, 38,563,783 bytes, SHA256 `0eb901aab4ddb0f22875e75b57b97e12b2c15e799b220879ac4a66ec7815077b`. Git payload commit `e3563ae9d562bca0537cf2c2d3fca8426413b9f6`; delivery/C10 ACK follows at `79244fe24f444ed441ddc24e7518adc8a0aa45f0`. Dropbox ID `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_htg` at `/bianchi/research_backups/rei_bianchi/REI_TRITIUM_FULL_NETWORK_FINAL_20261022.zip`; Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sUw9xHZgV1khxe6haF3eZQ-S9wa1NYr4/view?usp=drivesdk . Complete remote downloads from both providers matched SHA256 and passed ZIP CRC. Exact IDs, status, and the repaired interim DD Git binary blobs are documented in `research/rei_tritium_production_audit_20261022/delivery/FINAL_DELIVERY_ACK.json`.

The reviewed reionization dossier is now published as an additive follow-up. This PR remains draft and does not merge or change production defaults.

## Reionization dossier delivery completed

`research/rei_reionization_dossier_20261022` now includes the reviewed source, Markdown report, individual figures, public NPZ histories, and PDF QA receipts. Payload commit: `c004c22ef938fdfbc7a135fcd4a31c2df0f25f12`; final delivery metadata ACK: `5a1e5220b301a1c497f2863d6fd823e605faba80`. All 123 payload and seven ACK blob uploads matched their local Git blob SHA. Publication performed zero scientific reruns and zero test replays; the scoped scientific claims remain unchanged.

The immutable source-restore archive has 567 members, 76,130,340 bytes, SHA256 `a6e50ee0aa86c55f46728e55df72bbb84a156317ca951f54ddf5af1ed413f758`. Dropbox ID `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_huA`; [Drive archive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pq7KtPNKxVoZ_NyqKXG_SVAxDoOweIMI/view?usp=drivesdk). Full remote downloads from both providers matched SHA256 and passed ZIP CRC.

The [original final PDF](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hxw8OgXcRxkvBvcsio1PQwoFvBgZFJx-/view?usp=drivesdk) is 17,997,787 bytes, SHA256 `a3a642c3971a545eac4f119b1b38cc4e4fe610edac5537a46d8ef7442c4a914e`; its separate Drive full download also matched the original. This complete PDF is excluded from Git because the base64 Git object request exceeds the connector's 16 MiB request limit. Its original bytes remain preserved in both verified archives and on Drive. No new delivery ZIP was uploaded to Git.

`delivery/FINAL_DELIVERY_ACK.json` supersedes the archive's historical deferred delivery state without changing that immutable snapshot or the historical local receipts. C10 is COMPLETE and `COUPLED_ISOTOPE_NATIVE_CONTRACT` is READY. `COUPLED_ISOTOPE_NATIVE_PRODUCTION` remains HOLD_DEPENDENCIES.

The seven final delivery metadata files are also preserved in a [metadata supplement](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xr6h7REz4e74gVomH0_9jIVatGdOSFal/view?usp=drivesdk): 13,764 bytes, SHA256 `bf5fbbdf999b3951b54535b8ec4a603104ce722c2ea004771e74728fa85e5e13`; Dropbox ID `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_huQ`. Both complete remote downloads matched SHA256 and passed ZIP CRC. This supplement preserves the current ACK alongside the unchanged source archive.
